plan.understanding: Add a top-mounted fixation rod (arm) to the existing bracket, with a 200 mm arm length, so the part can be used to fix/hold a cutting product.

subtasks.goal: Add a cylindrical fixation rod mounted on the top at the existing top-hole location: create a new solid cylinder coaxial with the top hole axis (axis [0.0,1.0,0.0] from cylindrical faces #29/#5), centered at the hole mouth on planar face #6 (c=[67.5,180.0,-21.0]), with rod diameter d=14.035 mm (match r=7.0175 of face #29) and arm/rod length 200.0 mm extruded in the +Y direction from the top face. Verify the rod’s far-end center lands at approximately [67.5, 380.0, -21.0] and correct direction if it extrudes into the part (toward -Y).
